items.job: Replace both head gaskets and resurface heads
items.note: A timing belt and water pump are often done at the same time. Cost rises if the heads are warped or cracked.

items.job: Replace AWD transfer (duty C) solenoid
items.note: Check tire sizes and fluid first. If the transfer clutch is worn, the transmission may have to come out.

items.t: Front control arm brackets can rust and break
items.job: Replace front lower control arms per recall
items.note: Covered by a recall for many trucks in salt states. Check your VIN. Add a wheel alignment.

items.job: Replace front catalytic converter (Y-pipe)
items.note: Fix misfires or head gasket leaks first, or the new converter can fail too.

items.job: Replace front wheel bearing
items.note: Price is per side.

items.job: Replace turbocharger and oil feed line
items.note: Cost rises a lot if oil starvation also damaged the engine bearings.

items.job: Replace rusted brake lines per recall
items.note: Covered by a recall for many cars in salt states. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Rear center seat belt may not hold a child seat
items.job: Replace rear center seat belt assembly per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.job: Replace short block (piston rings)
items.note: A class action extended coverage for many cars. Ask a dealer for an oil use test and check your VIN.

items.job: Replace CVT valve body and refill fluid
items.note: Subaru extended CVT coverage on many cars. Check your VIN. A full CVT replacement costs far more.

items.job: Replace brake light switch per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Turbo intake duct can crack and stall the engine
items.job: Replace turbo air intake duct per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated
items.job: Repair passenger seat sensor mat harness per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.job: Test for parasitic drain and replace battery
items.note: Ask a dealer about software updates for the drain. Finding a module drain can take extra diagnosis time.

items.job: Replace in-tank low-pressure fuel pump per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: PCV valve can break apart inside the engine
items.job: Replace PCV valve per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. If broken pieces are lost in the engine, the short block is replaced.

items.t: Electric power steering assist can cut out
items.job: Inspect and replace steering gearbox per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. Add a wheel alignment if the gearbox is replaced.

items.t: Rear stabilizer bar bracket bolts can loosen
items.job: Retorque or replace stabilizer bracket bolts per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.job: Replace thermo control valve and refill coolant
items.note: Subaru extended coverage on this valve for many cars. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Windshield cracks with no clear impact
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate EyeSight camera
items.note: Glass insurance may cover it. Cars with EyeSight need a camera recalibration after the swap.

items.t: Some 18-inch wheels may not seat properly
items.job: Inspect and replace affected wheels per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.job: Check bond and replace moonroof glass panel per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.
